info.title: Record Identifier
info.description: System-generated unique identifier assigned to each record in the database. Used to uniquely identify a row within a resource table.
info.comment: Automatically populated. Not publisher-maintained. Values are unique within a resource and may be used for record retrieval and updates.

info.title: Last Updated Timestamp
info.description: System-generated timestamp indicating when the record was last created or modified in the database.
info.comment: Automatically maintained. Useful for identifying recently changed records. Stored in UTC.

info.title: Auction ID
info.description: Unique auction identifier. Stable across all products auctioned in the same market window.
info.comment: Primary-key component; pairs with product_code to uniquely reference a cleared bid.

info.title: Product Code
info.description: Product mnemonic for the balancing service (e.g. DCL, DCH, FFR).
info.comment: Primary-key component; controlled vocabulary maintained by the market operator.

info.title: Delivery Start (UTC)
info.description: First instant of the delivery window. Stored as UTC; clients render local time.
